entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Visual Studio automatically interprets VB6 as VB.Net and formats .frm, .vbp, .cls & .bas as such #82489

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11520.70 #82485

PullRequests

Created

  • Small allocation optimization to SyntaxFacts.HasYieldOperations #82491
    Area-Compilers
  • IDecompilationService - Use Assembly.GetName().Version rather than FileVersionInfo.GetVersionInfo #82490
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode
  • Backport of "Extensions: Merge lookup of classic and new extensions" to `release/insiders` #82488
    Area-Compilers
  • Target Roslyn servicehub to net10 #82487
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Migrate Microsoft.VisualStudio.LanguageServices ServiceHub services to .NET 10 #82486
    Area-Infrastructure

Updated

  • Extension indexers: indexing with implicit indexers #82453
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Indexers
  • Avoid duplicate error with ambiguous user-defined conversion #82395
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Improve nav-to fuzzy pre-filtering with q-gram bigram bitset and corrected length thresholds #82457
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Unsafe evolution: warn for using the attribute under legacy rules and some cleanup #82456
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Extensions: fix crash with targeted attribute on extension block #82463
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Support `dotnet_diagnostic` options for source generated files #82470
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • File-based apps: csproj-in-cone check #82327
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
